{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Mining Laser''' is a continuous-beam mining hardpoint that cuts ordinary resource fragments from a mineable asteroid. Fragment release depends on the mining power applied to the rock, so stronger or additional mining lasers release the asteroid's finite fragment supply more quickly.<ref name="laser">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Mining_Laser Mining Laser], Elite Dangerous Wiki.</ref>

A Mining Laser does not identify an asteroid's contents, retrieve the fragments, or process them. Those roles belong to the [[Prospector Limpet Controller]], [[Collector Limpet Controller]], and [[Refinery]]. The complete operating workflow is covered by [[How to Laser Mine]].

== Standard variants ==

Standard Mining Lasers are D-rated Class 1 or Class 2 hardpoints with fixed and turreted mounts. Both classes have a 500 m maximum mining range and use no ammunition.<ref name="laser" />

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Variant !! Mass !! Integrity !! Power draw !! Distributor draw !! Thermal load !! Base value
|-
| 1D fixed || 2.00 t || 40 || 0.500 MW || 1.5 MW || 2.0 || 6,800 CR
|-
| 1D turreted || 2.00 t || 40 || 0.500 MW || 1.5 MW || 2.0 || 9,400 CR
|-
| 2D fixed || 2.00 t || 51 || 0.750 MW || 3.0 MW || 4.0 || 22,576 CR
|-
| 2D turreted || 2.00 t || 51 || 0.750 MW || 3.0 MW || 4.0 || 32,576 CR
|}

The Class 2 laser applies more mining power and releases fragments faster than the Class 1 version, but doubles distributor draw and thermal load. Additional lasers increase the release rate again while drawing from the same finite prospected asteroid supply.<ref name="laser" />

A turreted Mining Laser functions as a full turret only when controlled by a Multicrew gunner. It does not create an automatically aimed mining solution for a solo pilot.<ref name="laser" />

== Fragment generation ==

The beam must strike the asteroid continuously within range. Each released fragment inherits commodity percentages from the asteroid's ordinary prospected composition. The fragment is then collected and refined; the laser itself does not add cargo.

An attached prospector limpet increases the total ordinary fragment supply according to the prospector controller's rating. Mining before the prospector attaches forfeits the multiplier on fragments already removed. The laser's class controls extraction speed, while the prospector controls the documented yield multiplier.

Mining lasers draw from the WEP capacitor and generate heat during continuous use. If distributor capacity is exhausted, the beam stops until sufficient weapon energy recovers. Power-distributor capacity, cooling, the number of lasers, and collector throughput therefore determine whether additional lasers improve the complete mining loop.

== Modified Mining Laser ==

The '''Modified Mining Laser''' is a pre-Engineered Class 1 fixed variant available as a per-copy material exchange from the Human Technology Broker at The House Ascendant in the 21 Eridani system. It is supplied with a special combination of Long Range, reduced distributor demand, and Incendiary Rounds that cannot be reproduced or replaced by ordinary Engineering.<ref name="laser" />

Compared with a standard 1D fixed laser, current module documentation lists:<ref name="laser" />

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Attribute !! Modified variant
|-
| Maximum range || 2,500 m
|-
| Power draw || 0.25 MW
|-
| Distributor draw || 0.75 MW
|-
| Thermal load || 1.0
|-
| Integrity || 20
|}

Removing the supplied modifications permanently converts the module away from its special configuration; Engineers cannot reapply them.<ref name="laser" />

== Other laser-mining tools ==

The [[Mining Lance]] is a separate Class 1 Powerplay weapon with standard Class 1 mining performance, 2,000 m range, and limited combat capability. Its acquisition and weapon characteristics belong to its own article.

'''Mining Volley Repeaters''' are separate current-Live precision mining tools fitted through ship-specific Mining Optimised hardpoints. They are not standard Mining Laser variants and do not share the specifications above.

=== Type-11 Mining Volley Repeater ===

The original '''Mining Volley Repeater''' is restricted to the Type-11 Prospector. Frontier describes it as producing more fragments than other laser-mining tools and having a chance to generate higher-density fragments.<ref name="type11">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/type-11-prospector-highlights Type-11 Prospector Highlights], Frontier Developments, 5 September 2025.</ref><ref name="update4210">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/update-notes/4-2-1-0 Elite Dangerous: Type-11 Prospector Update], Frontier Developments.</ref>

=== Mk II Mining Volley Repeater ===

Update 4.4.2.0 added a distinct '''Mk II Mining Volley Repeater''' for the [[Anaconda Mk II]]. The ship supports two Mk II Mining Optimised hardpoints for this module.<ref name="anaconda-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-october-dev-log-2026-law-disorder Elite Dangerous: October Dev Log 2026 — Law & Disorder], Frontier Developments, 14 October 2026.</ref><ref name="anaconda-update">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-2-0 Elite Dangerous: Anaconda Mk II Update], Frontier Developments, 20 October 2026.</ref>

The Mk II module is not the Type-11's original Mining Volley Repeater. Frontier has not published enough verified specifications to compare their range, power or distributor demand, thermal load, mining output, or fragment-density effect.

== Method boundaries ==

A Mining Laser works only on the ordinary composition of a mineable asteroid. It does not remove named surface deposits, drill sub-surface deposits, or place charges in fissures. Those targets require an [[Abrasion Blaster]], [[Sub-surface Displacement Missile]], or [[Seismic Charge Launcher]] respectively.

Its beam has very short range, low combat damage, and low armour penetration. Although it can damage ships, it is a mining tool rather than a practical defensive weapon.<ref name="laser" />

== Engineering ==

Standard Mining Lasers do not accept ordinary Engineer blueprints. The Modified Mining Laser's supplied configuration is fixed, while the Mining Lance and both Mining Volley Repeater variants are separate modules with their own restrictions.

== Field Procedure ==

[[How to Laser Mine]] covers equipment preparation, prospecting, positioning, capacitor management, fragment collection, refinery operation, and completion checks.
